Photo 1: Screen shows 'About' section in Settings. Model Name: iPhone 18 Pro. Model Number: NURW4ZDJA. Serial Number: CX4D37C8NG. Capacity: 512 GB. iOS Version: 27.2. The text is clear and legible.
